model-value.desc: Model of the component; must be Array if using 'multiple' prop

options.desc: Array of options the user can select from (strings or objects with label/value/disable)

option-value.desc: Property of option which holds the value

option-label.desc: Property of option which holds the label

option-disable.desc: Property of option which tells it's disabled

multiple.desc: Allow multiple selection; model must be Array

emit-value.desc: Update model with the value of the selected option instead of the whole option

map-options.desc: Try to map labels of model from options Array

use-input.desc: Use an input tag where users can type

use-chips.desc: Use QChip to show what is currently selected

fill-input.desc: Fills input with current value; useful with 'hide-selected'

new-value-mode.desc: Enables creation of new values: 'add', 'add-unique', or 'toggle'

hide-selected.desc: Hides selection; use underlying input to hold the label

options-cover.desc: Expanded menu will cover the component

input-debounce.desc: Debounce the input model update in milliseconds

label.desc: A text label that will float above the input field

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

clearable.desc: Appends clearable icon when a value is set

loading.desc: Signals the user a process is in progress by displaying a spinner

behavior.desc: Overrides showing as menu on desktop and dialog on mobile

popup-content-class.desc: Class definitions for the popup content

no-option.desc: What the menu displays when no options match the filter

loading.desc: Override default spinner when in loading state

before-options.desc: Content rendered before the list of options

after-options.desc: Content rendered after the list of options

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the model value changes

input-value.desc: Emitted when the text input value changes

filter.desc: Emitted when user wants to filter options

add.desc: Emitted when an option is added to selection

remove.desc: Emitted when an option is removed from selection

new-value.desc: Emitted when a new value has been created

popup-show.desc: Emitted when the options menu/dialog is shown

popup-hide.desc: Emitted when the options menu/dialog is hidden
